channel.title: The Deliberate Pause
channel.description: Mental training for Indian entrepreneurs and founders. Sourced from spiritual practice. Proven by sports.

item.title: The Hidden Cost of Not Choosing Yourself
item.description: Why high achievers can confuse success with identity, and why not choosing yourself can become the most expensive decision of all.

item.title: The Clauddiction Trap
item.description: Claude makes me ship faster than ever but keeps me restless and pivoting. Starting again is not the same as building well. This essay explores the real cost of AI speed, the power of stillness, and why constant pivots are quietly destroying depth

item.title: When Success Still Feels Empty
item.description: Why high achievers can feel empty even after success, and how a 20-minute audit can reveal what’s really missing.

item.title: Angry Young Vijay’s Disappointment
item.description: Why high-achievers turn disappointment into anger, and how that hidden emotion spills onto the people closest to them.

item.title: Does happiness feel ‘different’?
item.description: Why high-achievers struggle to feel happiness and how suppressing pain ends up suppressing everything else, including joy.

item.title: The Market for Your Honest Opinion Is Bigger Than You Think
item.description: Why avoiding hard conversations feels safe but silently erodes trust, clarity, and performance and how speaking up changes everything.

item.title: The Rehearsal tax
item.description: Why replaying past failures feels like reflection but actually traps you in loops that drain clarity, confidence, and decision-making.

item.title: The Aliveness Paradox
item.description: Why happiness isn’t the reward for success—but the prerequisite. And how saying no can unlock deeper focus, clarity, and excellence.

item.title: The Dark Side of Self-Love
item.description: Why the modern obsession with self-love may be making us more anxious and how dropping the ego’s importance leads to real peace.

item.title: The Thermostat Effect
item.description: Why willpower alone can't change behaviour—and how your environment quietly shapes identity, focus, and success.

item.title: The Secret Inside the Brown Box
item.description: At his memorial, Jobs gave every guest one final gift. Not an Apple device. A book. Here's what the world's most competitive people are finding inside it.

item.title: The founders’ Olympics of suffering
item.description: Why modern startup culture rewards burnout over results, and how recovery—not grind—is the real driver of clarity and performance.

item.title: A ‘must’ update for the algorithm of love
item.description: Why modern dating optimizes for safety over connection and how risk, rejection, and uncertainty actually lead to lasting love.

item.title: Until Death, All Defeat Is Psychological
item.description: A true startup story backed by biology and history showing why grit alone kills companies—and how quitting strategically preserves agency, sanity, and future success.

item.title: The False Sense of Agency
item.description: Why gambling, crypto, and spiritual escapism are two sides of the same crisis. A deep essay on lost agency, AI fear, and finding your Swadharma.

item.title: The cartoonist monk who saved my life
item.description: How Scott Adams’ ideas helped a founder survive burnout and rebuild life using systems, skill stacking, and energy management.

item.title: Steve Jobs Wasn't Complete. Neither Are You
item.description: Intelligence + Desire = 38% of Success. The Missing 62% Separates Legendary Founders from the Rest

item.title: The Low Status Moat Matters
item.description: Founders and leaders hit invisible limits when they avoid looking like beginners. This essay explains the Low Status Moat—and how crossing it builds agency.

item.title: No means, no to hustle culture
item.description: Elite founders don’t win by being busy. This essay explains how selective unavailability unlocks better decisions, deeper thinking, and long-term advantage.

item.title: Fall in Love with 2026 sooner than later
item.description: Get a head start on 2026. Discover ideas, trends, and insights that help you embrace the future with confidence and excitement.

item.title: Heroes Ask for Help
item.description: Asking for help isn’t weakness—it’s strategic intelligence. Backed by research from Harvard and Wharton, this essay explains why bold requests accelerate leadership, learning, and success.

item.title: The Unicorn Trap and the road to ‘enlightenment’
item.description: A reflective journey on startup culture, happiness, and identity—why chasing unicorns fails founders, and how Inner Engineering leads to clarity, autonomy, and “enough.”

item.title: Busy but Broke? Your Fake Work Is Keeping You Poor.
item.description: Discover why long to-do lists create fake work, keep founders stuck, and lead to burnout. Learn the system that replaces busyness with real results.

item.title: Your attention span holds a secret
item.description: Discover why multitasking drains your brain, kills deep work, and lowers decision quality. Learn the science behind attention, the real ‘switch cost’, and how structured focus and rest can 10× your cognitive performance.

item.title: ‘Rest assured’, this competitive advantage can set you apart
item.description: Founders don’t win by grinding harder—they win by recovering smarter. Learn why sleep, rest, and recovery drive better decisions, creativity, and long-term performance.

item.title: Force multiplier for the zero-cost builder
item.description: AI is reshaping work at unprecedented speed. Learn why judgment, taste, and rapid learning—not team size—define success, and why waiting is the biggest risk today.

item.title: Rejection hurts, but don’t let it be painful
item.description: Discover how to turn rejection into resilience. Learn the science behind emotional pain, exposure therapy techniques, and mindset shifts that help founders recover faster, think clearly, and grow stronger through every ‘NO’.

item.title: My rejection experiment that can be your breakthrough
item.description: What happens when you stop chasing approval and start studying rejection? Through ten deliberate ‘NOs’, learn how loss aversion, ego, and identity shape founder behavior—and why mastering rejection may be your ultimate competitive edge.

item.title: Smart but stuck: When intelligence alone falls short of cracking the startup code
item.description: Discover why intelligence alone can trap founders in overthinking and how action, not analysis, builds startups. Learn to act decisively at 70% certainty.

item.title: To weave your startup story, invoke the storyteller in you
item.description: Your startup pitch isn’t about data it’s about belief. Learn how storytelling transforms founders into leaders who inspire investors, teams, and users.
